papers.title: HuatuoGPT-o1, Towards Medical Complex Reasoning with LLMs

training_data.name: Medical O1 Reasoning SFT
training_data.quote: This dataset is constructed using GPT-4o, which searches for solutions to verifiable medical problems and validates them through a medical verifier.

description.text: This repository contains the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B model fine-tuned for advanced medical reasoning tasks. The model has been converted to GGUF format for efficient inference with CPU and GPU backends, making it compatible with tools like llama.cpp and ollama.

output_type.quote: ollama run deepseek-medical-q8_0 "A 61-year-old woman with involuntary urine loss during coughing but no leakage at night undergoes a gynecological exam and Q-tip test. What would cystometry reveal about residual volume and detrusor contractions?"

serving.notes: The llama.cpp example uses --temp 0.7. The released file unsloth.Q8_0.gguf is an 8-bit GGUF; the Hub GGUF header reports 8,030,261,312 parameters and context 131072. The same repository also contains four float16 pytorch_model.bin shards. The card does not state LoRA rank, alpha, whether the adapter was merged, or whether the base was quantized during training. Q8_0 is the inference file format. A same-author LoRA repository, NikkeS/deepSeek-finetuned-Medical-O1-Reasoning-SFT, states rank 16, alpha 16, and quantization FP16, and uses the same step count, seed 3407, and example question; this card does not link that repository. The card's own repository link uses a different id and returned HTTP 401. The chat template does not set a medical system prompt. No paper names this repository.

discrepancies: The card states LoRA, the dataset id, and the parent, which match the inventory. The card does not name supervised fine-tuning as the objective. The letters SFT appear in the dataset id and the repository name, which are not a statement of the loss.
